maya (eng-ml): heads-up — int4 bringup at 5% is showing a small but consistent quality delta on customer prompt set A. not severe but > our auto-fallback delta.
jaun (eng-runtime): details? which metric tripped? precision/recall/semantic-sim?
sasha (eng-ml): our docqa BLEU-ish proxy dropped ~2.7%, hallucination rate up 1.1% on that subset.
maya (eng-ml): exact numbers: baseline float32 f1=0.812, int4 f1=0.790. halluc metric (entity halluc per 1k)=4.2 -> 5.3.
olivia (eng-sre): is latency/change acceptable? any perf upside that offsets quality?
maya (eng-ml): latency improves ~7% p50, cost per token ~12% down. but product flagged quality.
tariq (product): product wants conservative: automatic fallback trigger is delta_f1 >= 2% OR halluc_increase >= 0.9 per 1k with N>=2000 samples. this exceeds both rules.
maya (eng-ml): we hit both thresholds. rollout is at 5% (canary). we should trigger auto-unwind if policy matches.
deploy-bot: rollout-update: model-int4-v3 -> allocation increased from 0.05 to 0.20 at 2117779400 by ci/auto-promote
juan (eng-runtime): wait — how did it jump to 20%? auto-promote should have paused on signal. checking rollout policy logs.
juan (eng-runtime): found policy: "rapid-promote": promote after smoke if p95 latency < 200ms and smoke_f1 delta < 1.5%. smoke job uses smaller sample (N=200) — noisy.
sasha (eng-ml): oh right — smoke job passed, larger production eval failed. we need hysteresis and sample-min enforcement before promoting.
maya (eng-ml): proposed quick action: pause further traffic, trigger automatic rollback to float32 variant for affected routes, and add guard: require prod-eval N>=1000 AND hysteresis window 30m with no >1% regression.
olivia (eng-sre): agree. also add circuit quench: if auto-rollback executes, block auto-promote for 24h for that model family.
tariq (product): fine. also let's record a customer-facing note but hold public comms until we validate rollback.
juan (eng-runtime): executing rollback command now: `infra rollout set model-int4-v3 allocation 0.0 --fallback model-f32-v12 --routes "docqa/*"` — will post status.
deploy-bot: rollout-update: model-int4-v3 allocation set to 0.0 at 2117780601 by juan (eng-runtime)
maya (eng-ml): thanks. I'll run an expanded eval across other prompt families to see if it's localized or global.
sasha (eng-ml): will prepare a diff report and suggested quant tweaks (recalibration + per-layer ptq rescale). aim to re-run shadow with logging.
juan (eng-runtime): policy change task created: add prod-sample-min + hysteresis + 24h block. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollout-policy/pulls/142
maya (eng-ml): note for postmortem: consider decoupling smoke promotion from auto-increase and require a second validation signal: shadow pass or prod-eval.
olivia (eng-sre): filing a short incident ticket so oncall sees the rollback and verifies no cascading outages.
tariq (product): thanks everyone. keep updates tight — want re-propose in this thread when we have corrected quant config and shadow pass. :thumbsup:
maya (eng-ml): will do. next steps: expanded eval (maya), quant tweak PR (sasha), runtime guard PR (juan). back in ~3h with early results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
